sentences: If the power cut lasts a long time, the food in the fridge will go bad.
إذا استمر انقطاع الكهرباء وقتًا طويلًا، سيفسد الطعام في الثلاجة.
If you don't call a plumber, the leak will get worse.
إذا لم تتصل بسبّاك، سيزداد التسريب سوءًا.
My phone battery is dead. Can I use your charger?
فرغت بطارية هاتفي. هل يمكنني استخدام شاحنك؟
We got stuck in the lift for twenty minutes.
علقنا في المصعد عشرين دقيقة.
If it's faulty, they'll give you a refund.
إذا كان معيبًا، فسيُعيدون إليك ثمنه.

grammar.intro_en:
First conditional: If + present simple, will + verb — a real possibility in the future
If it rains, we'll stay at home. · We'll stay at home if it rains.
when / as soon as + present simple for things that are sure to happen: I'll call you when I arrive.
grammar.intro_ar: لأننا نقول بالعربية «لو هتمطر هنقعد في البيت»، يضع المتعلم will بعد if: If it will rain ✗. القاعدة: بعد if و when و as soon as و unless نستخدم المضارع البسيط حتى لو كان المعنى مستقبلًا، ونضع will في الجزء الآخر فقط. وإذا بدأت الجملة بـ if فضع فاصلة بين الجزأين. if = ممكن يحدث، أما when = متأكد أنه سيحدث.

rows: I'll take it back to the shop.
As soon as the plumber arrives,
Unless you hurry (= If you don't hurry),

notes: The result can also be can, should or an order: If you feel ill, you should see a doctor. · If you see Omar, tell him to call me.
unless = if … not. Don't add not after unless: Unless you hurry … (NOT Unless you don't hurry …).

exercises.title: Exercise 1 · Complete with the correct form (first conditional).
exercises.instructions: Complete with the correct form (first conditional).
items: 1) If you ___ (press) this button, the machine ___ (start).
2) If it ___ (not stop) raining, we ___ (stay) at home.
3) She ___ (be) angry if you ___ (forget) her birthday.
4) If they ___ (not repair) the lift, I ___ (complain).
5) What ___ you ___ (do) if you ___ (lose) your job?
6) If the battery ___ (die), I ___ (not be) able to call you.

exercises.title: Exercise 2 · Complete with if or when.
items: 1) I'll phone you ___ I arrive in Luxor. (I'm sure I'll arrive.)
2) ___ I finish work today, I'll go shopping. (I finish every day.)
3) ___ it's sunny tomorrow, we'll go to the beach. (Maybe it will be sunny.)
4) I'll make dinner ___ I get home. (I'm sure I'll get home.)
5) ___ you see a lost child, call the police. (Maybe you will see one.)

exercises.title: Exercise 3 · Correct the mistake.
items: 1) If it will rain, I'll take a taxi.
2) I'll call you as soon as I will get the results.
3) If you don't hurry, you miss the bus.
4) Unless you don't study, you'll fail.
5) When he comes, I tell him.
answers: 1) If it rains, I'll take a taxi.
2) I'll call you as soon as I get the results.
3) If you don't hurry, you'll miss the bus.
4) Unless you study, you'll fail. (or: If you don't study, you'll fail.)
5) When he comes, I'll tell him.

exercises.title: Exercise 4 · Translate into English.
items: 1) إذا تعطلت السيارة، سأتصل بك.
2) سأخبرك بمجرد أن أعرف.
3) إذا لم تتصل بالكهربائي، لن تعمل الأنوار.
4) عندما أصل إلى المكتب، سأرسل لك البريد الإلكتروني.
answers: 1) If the car breaks down, I'll (I will) call you.
2) I'll tell you as soon as I know.
3) If you don't call the electrician, the lights won't work.
4) When I get to the office, I'll send you the email.

write_speak: Write & Speak — “A problem at home”: write an email of 80–100 words to a shop or a landlord about a problem. Explain what happened (past simple), ask for a solution, and say what you will do if they don't help (first conditional). Then role-play the phone call with a friend.
other:
Example: Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to complain about the washing machine I bought from your shop in Nasr City two weeks ago. Yesterday it stopped working in the middle of a wash, and there was a big leak in my kitchen. The machine is still under guarantee, so I would like you to repair or replace it as soon as possible. If nobody comes this week, I will ask for a full refund. Please call me when your technician is available.
Yours faithfully,
Mona Adel
